name: water_entry
chapter: Into the water from the yacht's bow: running jump, swan dive, a fall from high up
note: l2_cliffclimb, the yacht's bow, from the spot and heading of tru.exe's runs under Wine (2026-11-15, openunderworld-work/waterentry-wine rj1/sw2/h3000; ours = tru + (-12446.2, -59357.3, 19003.8); docs/GAMEPLAY.md 'Water entry'). The volume's static top, where the entry starts, is z 108. tru.exe: a running jump off the bow went 66 under the waves (root at z -275 at its deepest) and treaded once swim_jump_land (S104) ended, straight into the surface group S111 (no surfacing); the swan dive went in head first (S105 swim_swan_land) and on down to z -1237, 1165 under the waves, then stayed under (S154, the submerged swim); a fall from 3000 over the top went 367 under the waves (z -462) and was at the rest level 44.1 under them when S104 ended (S111 directly). Never a landing. Depths under the waves depend on the wave phase and the yacht's bob at take-off (ours and tru.exe's are not in phase), so the bounds are wide around the measured numbers; the depth under the static top is the steadier one.

expect.note: no landing on the surface, no surfacing: tru.exe S104 -> S111
tru.exe: 66 under the waves (ours 87.5 at this phase)
treading 44.1 under the waves [O]; tol for the waves' move within the tick
head first and on down: no landing, no roll, no surfacing
tru.exe: 1165 under the waves when swim_swan_land ended (ours 795: the deck was low in its bob at take-off)
no landing; surfacing only if the waves leave her under at the clip's end (tru.exe rose within S111 after the 6000 fall)
